title: sideritis libanotica subsp. kurdica
intro: Sideritis libanotica subsp. kurdica, commonly known as Kurdish mountain tea, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against various diseases and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Kurdish mountain tea include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-hypertensive effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety, muscle spasms, and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis libanotica subsp. kurdica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
